description: Header file defining the QrSegment class and its nested Mode class for QR code data segmentation, including factory methods, mode definitions, and data members.

classes.name: qrcodegen::QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, including mode, character count, and data bits.

classes.name: qrcodegen::QrSegment::Mode
classes.description: Defines the mode of a QR code segment, including constants for different encoding modes and methods to retrieve mode bits and character count bits.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Generates a list of segments to encode a given text string efficiently.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a segment representing an Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI) with a specified assignment value.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in numeric mode.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the segment.

methods.name: getNumChars
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the segment.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data bits of the segment.

methods.name: getTotalBits
methods.description: Calculates total bits for a list of segments at a specific QR code version.
